mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id,u.user_no,u.password,ifnull(u.event_remind,0) event_remind,u.psd_modified,u.company_id,u.dept_id,u.user_type_id,u.user_avatar_addr,u.user_sign_pic ,u.is_use,c.company_name company_name,d.dept_name dept_name FROM comm_system_user u LEFT JOIN comm_company c ON u.company_id=c.company_id LEFT JOIN comm_dept d ON u.dept_id=d.dept_id WHERE u.company_id NOT IN (SELECT distinct(ifnull(zxecg_company_id,'')) from sys_open_auth_user) AND u.user_no=#{userNo} OR ifnull(u.phone,'')=#{phone}

SELECT u.user_id,u.user_no,u.password,ifnull(u.event_remind,0) event_remind,u.psd_modified,u.company_id,u.dept_id,u.user_type_id,u.user_avatar_addr,u.user_sign_pic ,u.is_use,c.company_name company_name,d.dept_name dept_name FROM comm_system_user u LEFT JOIN comm_company c ON u.company_id=c.company_id LEFT JOIN comm_dept d ON u.dept_id=d.dept_id WHERE u.company_id NOT IN (SELECT distinct(ifnull(zxecg_company_id,'')) from sys_open_auth_user) AND u.user_id=#{userId}
